title: Floating up/down buttons for every session type
action: Per D1/D2: add two floating chevron buttons (up/down) to the terminal-detail view's markup, rendered for every session type (Claude/codex/agy alike -- no agent-kind branching, per D2's rationale). Position them position:absolute against a newly position:relative '.view-terminal' (styles.css:746-753, currently sets no position) bottom-right corner -- never position:fixed, matching this repo's existing mobile-Safari overlay precedent (styles.css:749, :1162-1165; '.term-viewport' itself is the scroll container per styles.css:930-939 and cannot be the positioning parent). Auto-hide the buttons after a period of idle (no touch/scroll interaction on the viewport); hide them outright (not just fade) whenever '.reply-sheet' or '.keys-pad' is not hidden, per D1's sheet-collision rule. Up-button tap calls the existing loadOlder() (terminal.ts:236-248) directly -- not sendKeys/the Keys-pad path (terminal.ts:337-344 is the wrong mechanism, per D3). Down-button tap performs the 'return to live' action from cell -1 (scrollTop=scrollHeight, resume poll, and an immediate void poll() per D7). Add tests: buttons render and are present for a non-Claude (e.g. codex-kind) AgentRow, not just Claude; tapping the up-button triggers exactly one history fetch (reuse the existing history-fetch-counting pattern at web/test/terminal.test.ts:220-233); tapping the down-button triggers the return-to-live path; buttons are hidden while the Reply or Keys sheet is open.

truths: the up/down buttons are present in the DOM for every session kind, not just Claude
tapping up triggers exactly one loadOlder()/history fetch
tapping down returns the viewport to the live bottom and resumes polling
the buttons are hidden whenever the Reply or Keys sheet is open

artifacts.substantive: up/down button markup and click handlers wired to loadOlder()/return-to-live
.view-terminal gets position:relative; new button styles use position:absolute, never fixed
new tests for button presence across agent kinds, up/down tap behavior, and sheet-collision hiding

key_links: up-button click handler calls the same loadOlder() function as the existing scroll-to-top trigger
down-button click handler reuses cell -1's return-to-live path
prohibitions: No position: fixed anywhere in the new CSS
No agent-kind/name branching to decide button visibility
No change to the Keys-pad's existing sendKeys-based key buttons
